$comment: Provenance + integrity manifest for the vendored files in assets/. scripts/check-vendored-assets.mjs recomputes each sha256 from disk and fails CI on any mismatch (deterministic, offline tamper/edit gate). The scheduled .github/workflows/vendor-drift.yml separately re-checks dig-embed.js against hub's canonical source (comment-stripped) to catch upstream CODE drift. Re-vendor flow + --update usage: runbooks/deploy.md. Vendored-assets contract: SPEC.md.

assets.parity_note: Carries the #2313 fail-closed rootIsPinned fix (canonicalize root + sentinel allowlist), applied locally here so this deployed asset does not silently skip the merkle-inclusion gate for a non-canonical pinned root; this matches hub's #2302 fix. hub_ref (f04aa79e) predates hub #2302, so this file now leads that ref — re-vendor + re-stamp hub_ref once hub's canonical dig-embed.js carries #2302. hub_ref is the hub commit last touching the source at vendor time.
